nodes.label: Bonjour Peer-to-Peer LAN Sync (_mdaily-sync._tcp)
nodes.rationale: Serverless local-network discovery and synchronization across Mac, iPad, and iPhone.

nodes.label: iPhone Duo Adaptive UI (Folded / Unfolded Right Rail + Inspector)
nodes.norm_label: iphone duo adaptive ui (folded / unfolded right rail + inspector)
nodes.rationale: Switches automatically between iPhone bottom glass dock, iPhone Duo right vertical rail (expanding Inspector when unfolded), and NavigationSplitView on iPad/Mac.

nodes.label: On-Device Vision OCR & Apple Foundation Models (AFM)
nodes.norm_label: on-device vision ocr & apple foundation models (afm)
nodes.rationale: Extracts amount, date, and note from receipt photos locally and powers bilingual Vietnamese/English AI financial assistant.

nodes.label: MDaily Pure Native SwiftUI Multiplatform App
nodes.norm_label: mdaily pure native swiftui multiplatform app
nodes.rationale: Pure Native SwiftUI personal finance app for macOS 26+ (Apple Silicon), iOS 26+, iPadOS 26+, and iPhone Duo adaptive UI using Xcode 27 and Swift 6.0.

nodes.label: Action Blue & Monochrome Surface Palette (#0066cc, #2997ff, #1d1d1f, #f5f5f7)
nodes.rationale: Single interactive accent (#0066cc light / #2997ff dark) on pure white, parchment (#f5f5f7), and near-black (#272729) tiles with zero decorative gradients.

nodes.label: Responsive Breakpoints & Collapsing Strategy
nodes.rationale: Multi-column utility grids collapse cleanly across phone, tablet, and desktop breakpoints with minimum 44x44pt touch targets.

nodes.label: SF Pro Display & Text Tight Typography Scale
nodes.norm_label: sf pro display & text tight typography scale
nodes.rationale: Negative letter-spacing at display sizes, 17px body copy, weight ladder 300/400/600/700 (omitting 500).

nodes.label: Apple Gallery Design System (DESIGN.md)
nodes.rationale: Photography-first interface with near-invisible chrome, alternating light/dark surfaces, and single Action Blue interactive accent.

nodes.label: Pill CTA Grammar, Radius Scale & Scale-0.95 Press State
nodes.norm_label: pill cta grammar, radius scale & scale-0.95 press state
nodes.rationale: Full-pill radius signals primary actions, 18px radius for utility cards, and uniform scale(0.95) press transform with only one product drop-shadow.
